svg.title: Browse, cache, and archive with ArchiveBox Proxy
svg.desc: Your browser exchanges requests and cached responses with archivebox-proxy. The proxy fetches cache misses from the internet, queues page captures in ArchiveBox, and reuses cached or archived responses. ArchiveBox runs normal captures through the same proxy and saves snapshots.
svg.text: Browse normally. Populate the cache as you go.
Cache responses for at least 24 hours
Replay saved responses when the cache expires.
